mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 950K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 950K, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% signals extreme monetary accommodation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased liquidity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in extreme accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 6.0% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and SPX correlation
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in two consecutive months signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening supply chain periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 3.5% on a YoY basis indicates robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP and SPX growth correlation
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50bps in a single month, indicating a rapid monetary policy response, leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased market liquidity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.005 over any 6-month rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in rapid rate cut periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) has been growing for at least 3 consecutive months, the sustained labor market strength drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5.5% and PAYEMS growth for 3+ months
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market trends and SPX performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 35% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) growth exceeding 5% on a YoY basis, indicating strong consumer spending, drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical retail sales and SPX correlation
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strong retail growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
